gloss: fine wine; fine sake; excellent liquor

definitions.gloss: fine wine; fine sake; excellent liquor
definitions.explanation: High-quality alcoholic beverage, especially sake or wine. Often used figuratively to describe the sweet taste of victory or success.

examples.japanese: ⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美酒|びしゅ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{酔|よ}う→酔う：14437_you⟧。
examples.english: To savor the sweet taste of victory.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{蔵元|くらもと}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧{美酒|びしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|う}み{出|だ}している→生み出す：10423_umidasu⟧。
examples.english: This brewery produces fine sake every year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実|みの}り→実る：00282_minoru⟧、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美酒|びしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{味|あじ}わった→味わう：04405_ajiwau⟧。
examples.english: Years of effort bore fruit, and the team savored the sweet taste of a championship victory.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{美|び}→美：28891_bi⟧ (beautiful, fine) + {酒|しゅ} (sake, liquor).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美酒|びしゅ} (the sweet taste of victory)
- {美酒|びしゅ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{酔|よ}う→酔う：14437_you⟧ (to savor fine sake; to revel in success)
- {美酒|びしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{味|あじ}わう→味わう：04405_ajiwau⟧ (to taste fine sake; to enjoy a sweet victory)

USAGE:
The figurative expression ⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美酒|びしゅ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{酔|よ}う→酔う：14437_you⟧ is extremely common in sports journalism and news. In literal use, {美酒|びしゅ} is a somewhat literary way to praise the quality of sake or wine.
